about: Nutrients per 100 g of one reference food per recipe ingredient, from Health Canada's Canadian Nutrient File. These are reference values for a generic food, not any product's label. A nutrient missing from per_100g (listed in `absent`) was not published for that food and is unknown, never 0.

sources.name: Canadian Nutrient File (API)
sources.edition: Not stated by the API documentation. Health Canada's CNF online search says it serves the 2015 CNF; that the API serves the same edition is assumed, not verified. These are not the CNF 2026 files.
sources.licence: Open Government Licence - Canada is stated on the CNF 2026 dataset record (open.canada.ca); the API documentation states no licence, so its coverage of the API data is not verified.
sources.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
